描述_EN: the central red panel is decorated with a four-clawed dragon rising above roaring sea waves and surrounded by clousd; at the corners are four daoist emblems (clockwise from top right): castanets, a gourd, a sheng musical instrument, and a fan; framed by a green border decorated with wavy floral stem. the top is edged with a band of dark blue cotton; the back is lined with red cotton. a slightly wider piece of the same material has been stitched across the top. it is decorated with two buddhist lions playing with a brocade ball, and surrouned by a green border of wavy floral stem. altar table frontal of cut voided satin velvet with red and green silk pile, brocaded in gilt paper strips.
描述_ZN: the central red panel is decorated with a four-clawed dragon rising above roaring sea waves and surrounded by clousd; at the corners are four daoist emblems (clockwise from top right): castanets, a gourd, a sheng musical instrument, and a fan; framed by a green border decorated with wavy floral stem. the top is edged with a band of dark blue cotton; the back is lined with red cotton. 顶部缝有一块稍宽的相同材料。 上面装饰着两个玩锦球的佛教狮子，周围是绿色的波浪形花茎的边框。 正面为红绿丝绒剪裁的空心缎面绒布，锦上添花的鎏金纸条。
